name: aihub
description: 把常用的 AI 聊天网站聚合到一个窗口里：多标签 + 拖拽分屏，每个站点独立数据目录，登录态互不干扰。Windows / macOS 桌面客户端（Tauri）
author: Aihub contributors

scripts.lint: node --check tools/build-icons.js && node --check tools/make-icon.js && node --check tools/check-ipc-contract.js && node --check tools/check-shell-assets.js && node --check tools/api-result-test.js && node --check tools/ui-module-smoke.js && node --check tools/login-crypto-crosscheck.js && node --check tools/login-migration-selftest.js && node --check tools/tauri-drag-selftest.js && node --check tools/cloudflare-guard-strand-test.js && node --check tools/export-cc-switch-logos.js && node --check tools/alias-hooks.mjs && node --check tools/bump-version.mjs && node --check tools/release.mjs
scripts.version: node tools/bump-version.mjs --sync && git add package.json package-lock.json src-ui/package.json src-ui/package-lock.json src-tauri/Cargo.toml src-tauri/Cargo.lock src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.lint:ui: node tools/check-ipc-contract.js && npm --prefix src-ui run build && node tools/check-shell-assets.js
scripts.test:ui: npm run lint:ui && npm run test:ui-module && npm run test:api-result && npm run test:login-crypto && npm run test:cf-guard
